mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, price, img, abv, order_count FROM t_product ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, type, price, img, abv, order_count FROM t_product ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

where.if: AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR p.type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_product_feature pf WHERE pf.product_id = p.id AND pf.taste_known = TRUE)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_product_feature_tag ft WHERE ft.product_id = p.id AND ft.kind = 'TASTE' AND ft.tag = #{tag})

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_product_feature pf WHERE pf.product_id = p.id AND pf.aroma_known = TRUE)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_product_feature_tag ft WHERE ft.product_id = p.id AND ft.kind = 'AROMA' AND ft.tag = #{tag})

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, price, img, abv, order_count FROM t_product WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product (name, type, price, img, abv, order_count) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{price}, #{img}, #{abv}, COALESCE(#{orderCount}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, price = #{price}, img = #{img}, abv = #{abv}, order_count = #{orderCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, price, img, abv, order_count FROM t_product ORDER BY order_count DESC, id ASC LIMIT 12
SELECT id, name, type, price, img, abv, order_count FROM t_product WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
